name: ai-knowledge-writing-skill
title: AI Knowledge Workbench
summary: Five-lane Codex workbench for source reading, visualization briefs, GitHub Pages surfaces, task queues, and precision review.
detail: A route-first knowledge workflow that turns scattered source reading, page building, and public-safe writing into repeatable lanes.

name: med-research-ai-navigator
title: Medical Research AI Navigator
summary: Three-lane navigator for medical research planning: statistics, bioinformatics, and paper-ready outputs.
detail: Built for clinical statistics, oncology bioinformatics, TCGA/GEO workflows, single-cell analysis, and manuscript packaging.

name: ai-product-teardown-studio
title: AI Product Teardown Studio
summary: Workbench for classifying repositories, mapping AI surfaces, extracting reusable patterns, and drafting originality-safe skills.
detail: Useful when turning external product observations into safe, original, reusable workflow ideas.

name: medical-review-topic-scout
title: Medical Review Topic Scout
summary: AI skill for scouting biomedical review topics from disease-mechanism and disease-biomarker pairs with PubMed evidence scanning.
detail: Designed to separate promising review angles from under-supported ideas before a manuscript project starts.

name: mr-study-copilot
title: MR Study Copilot
detail: A focused assistant for keeping MR study setup, checks, and interpretation closer to a reproducible analysis route.

name: oncobulk-research-copilot
title: Oncobulk Research Copilot
summary: Privacy-aware copilot for tumor-focused bulk transcriptome studies.
detail: A workflow layer for public or de-identified tumor transcriptome analysis, with privacy and claim-boundary guardrails.

name: multiplot
title: multiplot
summary: One-call ggplot2 extension that approximates default plot styles from 10 graphing software and academic publication style.
detail: An R package with 29 functions and a reproducible plotting workflow for Prism, SPSS, Origin, Stata, MATLAB, JMP, and more.

name: l-route-reflection-skill
title: L-route Reflection Skill
summary: A lightweight route-reflection skill for moving from 2023 to 2025 learning and work trajectories.
detail: A smaller planning artifact that keeps reflective route choices explicit rather than scattered across notes.
